evaluation.harrell_c_index: all observed follow-up; higher risk means earlier event

evaluation.ipcw_pr_auc: IPCW average precision on the same cumulative/dynamic horizon set

random_acquisition.selection_summary: minimum K=6 mean curve meeting validation target

bootstrap.stratification: event status within the unchanged test split
